This is substantially more specific than a common topic or routine clause.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"suspending certain statutory provisions relating employment the","parent_excerpt":"suspending certain statutory provisions relating employment the","explanation":"The titles share the same distinctive formulation, and C09 predates the child by roughly one year, consistent with reuse of an annual suspension-order template."},{"child_excerpt":"suspending certain statutory provisions relating employment the","parent_excerpt":"I hereby suspend for the fiscal year 1949 the application of those portions of the cited sections of the respective Acts which require employment of citizens of the Republic of Panama or of the United States in skilled, technical clerical, administrative, executive, or supervisory positions.","explanation":"C05 documents the concrete legal machinery used by this series: suspension, for a specified fiscal period, of statutory employment restrictions."}]}
